transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been feeling deeply depressed for a long time now, and I just can't seem to shake this constant, heavy sadness. It's been over a year, and I've lost all interest in everything I used to enjoy.
Have you experienced any periods over this past year where your mood felt significantly worse than usual, or has the intensity of your sadness remained relatively stable throughout?
It has been pretty stable, honestly. I've felt this same deep, heavy sadness every single day for the past year and one month, without any real change in how low I feel.
